# Recreation Prompt

Recreate a mobile portrait browser match-3 game called Lunar Heart Hunter. Preserve the core loop: an 8x8 board, tap/click one cell then an adjacent cell, attempt a swap, allow only swaps that create a horizontal or vertical line of three or more matching tokens, clear matches, score, cascade/refill, support combos, reject invalid swaps, and provide restart. Transform all presentation into a romantic moon-colony alien-hunter fantasy: a helmeted alien hunter with a heart antenna, cratered moon, colony dome, lunar ridge, orbiting hearts, glowing sci-fi token silhouettes, Affinity score, Chain meter, and concise mobile-readable instructions. Use browser-native Canvas/DOM/CSS and approved catalog fonts/audio only.
blueprint_markdown:
# Blueprint

## Source truth
- genre: mobile portrait match-3 puzzle game, originally presented as Candy Match 3 in a Construct-style canvas shell
- objective: swap adjacent board pieces to create rows or columns of three or more matching tokens, clear them, score, collapse, refill, and continue chasing higher score
- input model: tap/click one board cell, then tap/click an adjacent cell to attempt a swap; restart/CTA buttons remain native click targets
- core loop: inspect board, select adjacent pair, validate swap, clear matches, award score, cascade/refill, repeat
- fail/friction state: invalid or non-matching swaps are rejected/reverted; no hard loss state was required by the preserved loop

## Protected mechanics
- 8x8 match grid, adjacent two-cell swap intent, three-or-more row/column detection, non-matching swap rejection, scoring on cleared tokens, cascade/refill loop, continuous replay, restart reset, mobile tap actionability.

## Remix target
Lunar Heart Hunter rebuilds the same match-3 loop as a romantic moon-colony alien-hunter rendezvous. Alien tokens become love-signal specimens; scoring becomes Affinity; cascades become Chain vow bursts; invalid swaps are bounced signals. The implementation is rebuilt as a self-contained Canvas/vanilla JS public surface with procedural moon colony scenery, alien-hunter focal badge, romantic orbital hearts, and approved sci-fi audio/font media.
